text:
## Description

The program reads three integer sequences and a rank \(K\) from standard input. It prints the \(K\)-th largest value of \(A_iB_j+B_jC_k+C_kA_i\) over all choices of one index from each sequence.

## Preconditions

- PRE-1 (Unverified) — Standard input contains two integers \(N\) and \(K\) on the first line, followed by three lines of exactly \(N\) integers for \(A\), \(B\), and \(C\), respectively.
- PRE-2 (Unverified) — \(1 \le N \le 2 \times 10^5\) and \(1 \le K \le \min(N^3, 5 \times 10^5)\).
- PRE-3 (Unverified) — Each sequence entry is between \(1\) and \(10^9\), inclusive.

## Postconditions

- POST-1 (Unverified) — Standard output contains a single integer equal to the value at position \(K\) when the \(N^3\) scores are ranked from largest to smallest, starting at position 1. The score uses exact integer arithmetic.
- POST-2 (Unverified) — Every index triple contributes one rank position. Equal scores occupy separate positions, including when they arise from repeated sequence entries.
- POST-3 (Unverified) — When \(K=1\), the output is the maximum score. When \(K=N^3\) is permitted, the output is the minimum score. When \(N=1\), the sole score satisfies both cases.

## Test suggestions

- Check all three supplied samples against their expected outputs, including the all-equal scores in Sample 2 (POST-1, POST-2).
- Use \(N=1\), \(K=1\), and three entries of \(10^9\). Expect \(3 \times 10^{18}\) (PRE-2, PRE-3, POST-1, POST-3).
- For \(A=(2,1)\), \(B=(1,1)\), and \(C=(1,1)\), check that ranks 1 and 4 both return 5, and ranks 5 and 8 both return 3 (POST-1, POST-2, POST-3).

## Unspecified behavior

- Behavior for malformed input or values outside the stated constraints is unspecified.
- The task does not prescribe an order among triples with equal scores.
